levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: The leading «28-28» is the report number, not a chain.
«حدثنا أبي» gives the father as a bare relation; he is not named in the text.
«أبيه بشير الدهان» is one link whose surface is the name alone (rule 7).
The Imam «أبي عبد الش» stands inside the chain after «عن»: narrator. The Prophet is the end, not a link.
